name: Nail
overview: The Bible presents nails both as practical tools and rich symbols. Physically, nails were crafted from iron and gold, used in construction and securing important structures, as seen in David's preparation of iron nails for gates (1 Chronicles 22:3) and the golden nails in Solomon's temple (2 Chronicles 3:9). The story of Jael driving a nail into Sisera's head (Judges 4:21) illustrates their use as instruments of decisive action. Figuratively, nails represent stability and security, such as the 'nail in a sure place' symbolizing a firm and honored position given by God (Isaiah 22:23) and a source of hope and revival amidst adversity (Ezra 9:8), though this secured position can also be removed by divine decree (Isaiah 22:25).
